CustomField.description: Technical idempotency key for synthetic seed data (NS §33). Every record produced by the seed script carries this field with a value prefixed "NS-", so the load can be run more than once without duplicating records. The field has no business meaning and must not be used in reports, list views, or business logic.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Technical seed-data idempotency key (NS- prefix). No business meaning.
CustomField.label: Seed Key
